steps.step: H1.Floquet separation: U = T_eps W (one extra uncontrolled primitive step) puts all quasi-energy-0 nodes at the SAME chirality (net -2 per bcc zone), the opposite charges at quasi-energy -pi/2
steps.detail: 8 qe-0 nodes in the cubic zone (= 2 per bcc zone), net +8; other nodes at [np.float64(-1.5708)]

steps.step: H2.not a Weyl semimetal: the qe-0 cones are overtilted (|M^-T eps| > 1, type II) and det U = e^{-2i n.k} winds, so on EVERY k_z line the bands cross quasi-energy 0 at least 2|n_z| = 2 times: quasi-energy-0 surfaces (Floquet metal)
steps.detail: tilt ratio 1.732; zero crossings per random k_z line [2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2]

steps.step: H3.without tilt: every circuit of controlled single-axis shifts and on-site SU(2) coins is null-homotopic (each factor factors through a circle, pi_1(S^3) = 0), hence degree 0 and net chirality 0 at quasi-energy 0 and at pi; winding integral: BDT walk and six random circuits give 0, a (non-local) degree-1 control gives 1

H4.(statement) free-level chirality no-go for the walk architecture of Parts K/L/N: a chiral IR at quasi-energy 0 without quasi-energy Fermi surfaces is impossible (H2, H3, L5); the chiral Standard Model needs interactions -- a symmetric gap of the doubler sector (CHIRAL4D.NOMIRROR.01)
